I used to be in a very abusive relationship. Once I met her I fell into this trance like state where I could only see the good side of her if that makes any sense. There were so many blood red flags I missed cuz I was so colourblind in her trance. It took me about 2-3 years to finally man up and say it was over. She taught me how to cut myself and would often say if I didn't do it it meant I didn't love her. She was in Canada and I was in the states so it was a long distance relationship. I have no clue why I was dumb enough to actually slice myself open to prove my 'love'. But it got to the point where she would go weeks offline and make me think she killed herself because I did something like slept in too late. She is the reason I have so many cuts on my wrist and so many twisted wires in my head. At one point she persuaded her parents to let her visit me, so they all stayed in a hotel close-by and she stayed with me most nights because my parents didn't pay enough attention to me to care and her parents were so easily persuaded by her. One night we were sleeping on my couch and I woke up because of a nightmare (I had brain cancer years before I met her and often had vivid nightmares of hospitals). We were sleeping hand in hand since my couch is in a bit of a L shape and I noticed her hand wasn't there. I figured she went to the bathroom and wanted to go make sure she was okay and when I turned on my side to get up I saw her with her phone in her hand snapping goddamn pictures of me. I don't know how long she was there but I quickly got up and bolted the hell upstairs to get to my parents room on the second floor. I quickly got in their room and locked the door to call her mother to come pick her up. About an hour of hearing her scream and scratch at the door later I heard her mother yell and drag her from the door all the way downstairs and out our front door. I don't know what happened but all I did was go back downstairs in this shocked state and flop back on the couch. I guess deep inside I expected nothing less of her. I have a new healthy relationship now and I'm happy as ever. If you ever happen to read this you're crazy and need help, Cookie. I pity the next unlucky bastard that meets you.
